title: $\texttt{LensFactory.jl}$: A general-purpose strong lens modeling package
comment: 18 pages. 7 figures. Accepted in Journal of Astrophysics & Astronomy
summary: We present $\href{https://github.com/akmeena766/LensFactory.jl}{\texttt{LensFactory.jl}}$, an efficient, open-source, general-purpose strong lens modeling package written in Julia. It supports single- and multi-plane lensing with a wide range of analytic lens profiles, and its modular design, built on Julia's multiple dispatch, makes it straightforward to add new profiles or inference methods, while native multi-threading parallelizes the computationally expensive steps, enabling full cluster-scale lens reconstructions within hours on a desktop-class machine. We validate the mass-reconstruction pipeline of $\href{https://github.com/akmeena766/LensFactory.jl}{\texttt{LensFactory.jl}}$ on two simulated galaxy clusters (Ares and Hera), recovering the convergence and magnification maps well where the lensing constraints lie, and on the JWST-observed cluster SMACS J0723.3-7327, obtaining a strong lens model (image-plane RMS of 0.46'') consistent with previously published results. In addition, we introduce singularity maps as a complementary diagnostic for comparing lens models, probing differences in the higher-order derivatives of the lensing potential, which remain largely unconstrained by standard observables such as image positions, time delays, and flux ratios. $\href{https://github.com/akmeena766/LensFactory.jl}{\texttt{LensFactory.jl}}$ is accompanied by a set of worked examples covering all core functionality.

AI.tldr: 本论文介绍了LensFactory.jl，一个基于Julia编写的高效、开源、通用强引力透镜建模包，支持单平面和多平面透镜，利用Julia的多重分派实现模块化设计，并通过原生多线程加速计算密集型步骤，可在桌面级机器上数小时内完成星系团尺度的透镜重建。
AI.motivation: 强引力透镜建模需要高效且灵活的工具，现有软件在扩展性、计算效率或易用性方面存在不足，因此需要一个通用、模块化且高性能的开源强透镜建模软件包。
AI.method: 基于Julia语言开发LensFactory.jl，利用多重分派实现模块化设计方便添加新透镜profile和推断方法，采用原生多线程并行化计算耗时步骤，并在模拟星系团和JWST观测星系团上验证质量重建流程，同时引入奇异性图(singularity maps)作为比较透镜模型的新诊断工具。
AI.result: 在两个模拟星系团（Ares和Hera）上成功恢复会聚度和放大率图，在JWST观测的SMACS J0723.3-7327星系团上获得与已发表结果一致的强透镜模型（像平面RMS为0.46角秒），并展示了奇异性图作为透镜模型比较的补充诊断手段的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LensFactory.jl是一个高效且通用的强透镜建模工具，能够在桌面级机器上完成星系团尺度透镜重建，并提供了奇异性图作为标准观测量的补充诊断方法，配套提供了覆盖核心功能的完整示例。

title: LEGGOS: Direct abundances of N, O, Ne, S, and Ar in five lensed galaxies at Cosmic Noon
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to A&A
summary: We present direct $T_e$ chemical abundances in five strongly lensed galaxies at Cosmic Noon ($2.481 \leq z \leq 3.625$) using JWST/NIRSpec data from the LEGGOS survey. We measure gas-phase abundances of N, O, S, and Ar in all five galaxies, and Ne in two galaxies. Three galaxies have electron temperature constraints from multiple different ionization zones, and we find that these are broadly consistent with temperature scaling relations observed in both local and high-$z$ galaxies. We find a range of oxygen abundances $8.04 \leq 12+\log(\text{O/H}) \leq 8.79$ (22 -- 126\% $Z_{\odot}$). The ratios of N/O and Ne/O are consistent with trends observed in local galaxies. We do not observe any evidence for significant N enhancement in our sample, though the youngest galaxy in our sample (SGAS-J1050) has a mildly elevated $\log(\text{N/O}) = 1.20 \pm 0.08$, which we suggest may be driven by a population of young massive stars. The ratios of S/O and Ar/O are generally sub-solar, similar to trends observed in other high-$z$ galaxies. We find that the S/O and Ar/O abundances are sub-solar, consistent with enrichment from core-collapse supernovae (CCSNe). Modeling of the star formation histories of the LEGGOS galaxies supports CCSNe enrichment, as each galaxy shows a recent period of star formation lasting $\lesssim 100$ Myr, indicating that type Ia supernovae would not yet have had enough time to contribute significantly to the gas-phase abundances of these galaxies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用JWST/NIRSpec的LEGGOS巡天数据，对5个强引力透镜星系（z≈2.5-3.6）进行了直接电子温度（T_e）化学丰度测量，获得了N、O、S、Ar（以及部分Ne）的气相丰度，发现氧丰度范围约22%-126%太阳丰度，元素丰度比整体与局部和早期星系趋势一致。
AI.motivation: 在Cosmic Noon（宇宙正午，z≈2-4）时期，类星体通过引力透镜效应可以将高红移星系放大，使得JWST能够更精细地测量其化学丰度。此前对该时期的化学丰度测量有限，尤其是基于直接电子温度方法的元素丰度测量极为稀少。该研究旨在利用强引力透镜星系填充这一观测空白，深入理解早期星系的化学演化。
AI.method: 利用LEGGOS巡天的JWST/NIRSpec光谱数据，对5个强引力透镜星系（2.481≤z≤3.625）进行直接T_e（电子温度）诊断。测量气相中N、O、S、Ar的丰度（2个星系含Ne），通过多个电离区的电子温度约束交叉验证；结合恒星形成历史建模，评估不同来源（核心坍缩超新星vs Ia型超新星）对元素丰度的贡献。
AI.result: 5个星系的氧丰度范围12+log(O/H)=8.04-8.79（约22%-126%太阳丰度）；N/O和Ne/O与局部星系趋势一致，未发现显著的氮增强（但最年轻星系SGAS-J1050有轻微升高的log(N/O)=1.20）；S/O和Ar/O普遍低于太阳丰度，与核心坍缩超新星增丰模型一致。恒星形成历史建模显示每个星系都有近期的短时标恒星形成（≲100 Myr），不支持Ia型超新星有足够时间贡献。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究为Cosmic Noon时期星系的直接T_e化学丰度提供了珍贵的观测数据。结果表明该时期星系主要受核心坍缩超新星增丰主导，Ia型超新星尚未有时间显著贡献；元素丰度模式与局部和早期星系总体一致，未发现特殊的化学增丰异常。这为理解宇宙正午时期星系的化学演化提供了重要约束。

All targets have [O ii ] \(\lambda\lambda 7322,7332\) detections, three have [S iii ] \(\lambda 6314\) detections, and two have [O iii ] \(\lambda 4364\) detections at SNR \(>3\) . figures.caption_en: Figure 2 : The top panel shows an example joint fit of the [O ii ] \(\lambda\lambda 3727,3730\) doublet and the Balmer break for SGAS-J1110. The joint [O ii ]-Balmer break fits to the prism spectra yield [O ii ] \(\lambda\lambda 3727,3730\) fluxes consistent with those measured in the high (medium) resolution spectrum for SGAS-J1110 (SGAS-J1050). The [O ii ] fits for the G140H and G235M spectra of SGAS-J1110 and SGAS-J1050, respectively, are shown in the lower panels. In each panel, the dashed vertical lines show the initial line centers obtained by redshifting the vacuum wavelengths of the [O ii ] \(\lambda\lambda 3727,3730\) lines, and the dotted vertical lines show the best-fit line centers, which are consistent with the redshifted vacuum wavelengths within one resolution element. title: TDCOSMO XXIX: JWST/NIRSpec IFU Spatially Resolved Kinematics of Three Time-delay Lenses
comment: 23 pages, 18 figures, 6 tables; submitted to Physical Review D
summary: Spatially resolved stellar kinematics are critical to the high precision achieved by cosmological probes utilizing time delays of strongly lensed quasars. Combined with high-resolution imaging and lens modeling, dynamical models of the 2D resolved kinematics of the deflector galaxy tightly constrain the mass profile and break the mass-sheet degeneracy, in turn providing tight constraints on the Hubble constant when the time delays are included. We extract stellar kinematics of the deflector galaxies in the quadruply lensed quasar systems HE0435-1223, PG1115+080, and WFI2033-4723 from James Webb Space Telescope Near-Infrared Spectrograph (JWST-NIRSpec) integral field spectroscopy. The kinematic maps reach average per-bin total (statistical and systematic) uncertainties of 6-11%, with average bin-to-bin correlated errors of only $\sim 1.2\%$. The aperture-integrated velocity dispersions are statistically consistent with the values used in the previous TDCOSMO analysis (all within $0.9σ$), with their average uncertainty reduced from 3.7% to 2.4% owing to improvements in the data reduction and kinematic-extraction methodology. We classify PG1115+080 as a fast rotator, HE0435-1223 and WFI2033-4723 as slow rotators within the probed radii, and we refine the source redshifts from the kinematics of the lensed host galaxies. Kinematic maps will be combined with time delays, lens models, and line-of-sight convergence estimates to measure cosmological parameters in the upcoming TDCOSMO 2026 milestone publication.

title: A pilot submillimeter search for IceCube neutrino counterparts: JCMT follow-up and dusty-galaxy catalog associations
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to PASJ
summary: The submillimeter band offers a complementary route to identifying electromagnetic counterparts of high-energy neutrinos, tracing relativistic transients and persistent dust-obscured galaxies. We present a pilot search combining JCMT/SCUBA-2 follow-up of IceCube events with catalog searches for bright high-redshift dusty systems. Among nine rapidly observed IceCube fields, sources of particular interest were found in three: JCMT0402-0424 ("Shadow Blaster") in IC 210922A, a transient-like source following IC 220115A, and two known blazars in IC 240105A. ALMA resolved the Shadow Blaster into a strongly lensed dusty star-forming galaxy at z=2.988 with a compact gas-rich starburst core. Motivated by this result, we cross-matched IceCube localizations with the Herschel Bright Sources (HerBS) and Planck High-Redshift Source Candidate (PHZ) catalogs. Among 51 historical IceCube events with A_bbox,90 <= pi deg^2, four fields contain at least one HerBS source, compared with 0.723 expected from right-ascension scrambling (fixed-cut p=4.18e-3). Scanning the localization-area threshold gives p_global,A=0.0135. Applying the same IceCube selection to PHZ gives four associated fields versus 3.544 expected (p=0.478). Because the focused HerBS selection followed a broader exploratory analysis with trials-corrected p_global=0.130, the focused result is suggestive rather than definitive. The four well-localized HerBS fields contain six high-redshift DSFGs with apparent L_IR~10^13 L_sun. title: Observation-driven simulations of strong lensing galaxy clusters
comment: Accepted for publication in Astronomy & Astrophysics (15 pages, 10 figures), comments are welcome
summary: Galaxy clusters are the most powerful strong lenses: they greatly magnify the flux of distant and faint sources. Strong lensing also allows for the reconstruction of their mass distribution with-1% level accuracy and enables investigating cosmological parameters. The number of known systems of this type is bound to increase in the next years thanks to wide imaging surveys. Using simulations in this context is crucial to validate the analysis methods before they are applied to real data, and to train machine learning algorithms that can handle large volumes of images. In this work, we present a simulated set of one hundred images of galaxy clusters that we have produced with a novel code for simulating cluster-scale strong lenses. One of the main novelties of our approach, distinguishing it from other existing codes, is the use of empirical relations, derived from state-of-the-art observations, for modelling the characteristics, such as morphology, color, and spatial distribution of the cluster member population. This allows us to reliably reproduce the complexity of real observations. The simulations are partly carried out with the latest version of SkyLens, a code that creates mock observations of strong lensing events in different systems and observational setups. The main improvements we introduce are the use of the message passage interface (MPI) paradigm, a standard for parallel programming that leverages the use of several processors to perform some given task, and the implementation of score-based diffusion models to augment the images of the background sources. Together, they lead to more efficient and realistic image simulations. We also present the validation of the code and simulations by comparing the properties of the mock clusters to those of real ones. [Abridged]

title: TDCOSMO XXX: Spatially resolved kinematics of the deflectors in time-delay lens systems B1608+656 and SDSSJ1206+4332 from JWST-NIRSpec observation
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables; submitted to PRD
summary: We present spatially resolved stellar kinematics of the deflector galaxies in two time-delay lens systems, B1608+656 and SDSS J1206+4332, measured from JWST NIRSpec integral field spectroscopy. B1608+656 is a quadruply imaged quasar lensed by a pair of tidally interacting galaxies, the primary deflector (G1) and a close companion (G2), for which we quantified G2's tidal influence on G1 and define a criterion identifying the region where this perturbation is negligible and standard Jeans-equation modeling remains valid. SDSS J1206+4332 is a doubly imaged quasar whose extended host galaxy is itself quadruply imaged by a foreground massive galaxy (G0), accompanied by a fainter perturber (G1). For both systems, we report the first spectroscopic redshift and velocity dispersion measurements of the perturber galaxies. For G2 in B1608+656, we measure σ_v = 188 +/- 7 (stat.) +/- 2 (sys.) km/s at z = 0.6307, identical to the redshift of the main deflector G1. For G1 in SDSS J1206+4332, we find σ_v = 100 +/- 21 (stat.) +/- 2 (sys.) km/s at z = 0.7403, slightly lower than the primary deflector G0. The resolved velocity maps of both primary deflectors show clear rotation signatures and we visually classify them as fast or regular rotators. The data products will be made publicly available and will be combined with time delays, lens models, and line-of-sight convergence to measure cosmological parameters in the upcoming TDCOSMO 2026 milestone publication.

title: Harnessing stellar kinematics to constrain dark energy with the double-source-plane gravitational lens SDSS J0946+1006
comment: 18 pages, 16 figures, 3 appendices. Submitted to MNRAS. Comments welcome
summary: SDSS J0946+1006 is an attractive target for measuring cosmological parameters through lens modelling. It is the best-studied galaxy-scale strong gravitational lens with multiple sources whose redshift separations are well-suited to constraining the dark energy equation of state. However, multi-plane lens models with free cosmological parameters risk a multi-plane mass-sheet degeneracy, although this can be lifted by a non-lensing deflector density profile tracer. We simultaneously reconstruct near-infrared and near-ultraviolet HST imaging whilst including a velocity dispersion measurement from VLT-MUSE to constrain the foreground deflector. Imaging is reconstructed faithfully regardless of whether the inferred kinematics are realistic, though we find the kinematic constraint essential for shifting the preferred cosmology into a region not in significant tension with other dark energy probes. Deflector density profile perturbations, via substructure and multipolar halo shape deformations, have only a modest effect on inferred cosmology. Combining our fiducial model with Planck CMB data yields $w=-1.01^{+0.08}_{-0.13}$; or, combined with Pantheon SNe Ia, $w=-0.99^{+0.13}_{-0.15}$. We further show that this system proves a remarkably valuable complementary probe in the $w_{0}$-$w_{a}$ plane of an evolving dark energy model, and that the DESI BAO tension with $Λ$CDM seen when combined with other datasets is not reproduced when combined with this lens, yielding $(w_{0}, w_{a})=(-0.87^{+0.10}_{-0.11}, -0.22^{+0.28}_{-0.25})$. The system's third source, visible with MUSE, only weakly constrains $w$CDM but may strengthen $w_{0}w_{a}$CDM constraints, though further mass-model complexity along its line of sight is required. Overall, kinematics-informed multi-plane lens modelling is a robust route to competitive dark energy constraints, even with a single system.

AI.tldr: 本文利用引力透镜系统SDSS J0946+1006的多平面透镜建模，结合HST成像和VLT-MUSE速度色散测量，约束暗能量状态方程参数，得到与Planck和Pantheon数据一致的w值（约-1），并在w0-wa平面提供有价值的互补约束。
AI.motivation: SDSS J0946+1006是具有多个源的强引力透镜系统，其源的红移间隔非常适合约束暗能量状态方程。但自由宇宙学参数的多平面透镜模型面临质量片简并问题，需要引入非透镜方法测量的前景偏折体密度轮廓示踪物来解除该简并。本文旨在同时利用成像和运动学观测克服这一困难，检验该方法能否提供有竞争力的暗能量约束。
AI.method: 同时重建近红外和近紫外HST成像数据，并纳入VLT-MUSE观测的速度色散测量来约束前景偏折体。采用多平面透镜模型，内部包含自由宇宙学参数。通过运动学约束解除多平面质量片简并。研究中还检验了密度轮廓扰动（子结构和多极形状形变）对推断宇宙学参数的影响，并分别与Planck CMB数据和Pantheon SNe Ia数据组合进行联合约束。

artifacts.abstract_zh: SDSS J0946+1006是通过透镜建模测量宇宙学参数的一个有吸引力的目标。它是研究最充分的星系尺度强引力透镜，具有多个源，其红移间隔非常适合约束暗能量状态方程。然而，具有自由宇宙学参数的多平面透镜模型面临多平面质量片简并的风险，尽管这可以通过非透镜偏折体密度轮廓示踪剂来消除。我们同时重建近红外和近紫外HST成像，同时纳入VLT-MUSE的速度弥散测量以约束前景偏折体。无论推断的运动学是否真实，成像都能被忠实地重建，但我们发现运动学约束对于将首选宇宙学转移到与其他暗能量探针无显著张力的区域至关重要。偏折体密度轮廓扰动，通过次结构和多极晕形状变形，对推断的宇宙学影响不大。将我们的基准模型与Planck CMB数据结合，得到$w=-1.01^{+0.08}_{-0.13}$；或与Pantheon SNe Ia结合，得到$w=-0.99^{+0.13}_{-0.15}$。我们进一步表明，该系统在演化暗能量模型的$w_{0}$-$w_{a}$平面上是一个非常有价值的互补探针，并且与其他数据集结合时看到的DESI BAO与$\Lambda$CDM的张力在与该透镜结合时并未重现，得到$(w_{0}, w_{a})=(-0.87^{+0.10}_{-0.11}, -0.22^{+0.28}_{-0.25})$。系统的第三个源，通过MUSE可见，仅对$w$CDM提供弱约束，但可能加强$w_{0}w_{a}$CDM约束，尽管需要沿其视线方向增加质量模型的复杂性。总体而言，运动学信息约束的多平面透镜建模是获得有竞争力的暗能量约束的可靠途径，即使仅使用单一系统也能实现。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要，结论为：运动学信息约束的多平面透镜建模是获得有竞争力的暗能量约束的可靠途径，即使仅使用单一系统也能实现。该引力透镜系统是$w_{0}$-$w_{a}$平面上暗能量演化的有效互补探针。

title: LEGGOS: A Shocking Lack of Evidence for Shocks at sub-kiloparsec Scales at 2 < z < 4
summary: Here we present the first systematic search for shocks in six gravitationally lensed galaxies at 2.37 < z < 3.625 with JWST/NIRSpec integral field spectroscopy from the LEnsing and Galaxy Growth: Observing Substructures (LEGGOS) survey. We employ diagnostics that utilize the fluxes and kinematics of shock-sensitive rest-frame optical emission lines H\b{eta}, [O iii] λ5008, [O i] λ6302, Hα, [N ii] λ6585, and [S ii] λλ6718, 6733. We find that, on pixel, clump, and galaxy-integrated scales, the LEGGOS spectra show minimal if any evidence for shocks. The image plane pixels are < 8% within the shock regions of the rest-frame optical line ratio diagnostics for any individual galaxy, and the shock-identified pixels do not show a coherent spatial structure. We also leverage MAPPINGS V shock models to infer shock velocities from the observed emission lines, and find that the distributions of inferred shock velocities are inconsistent with those expected for shock-dominated gas. Altogether, none of these methods provide significant evidence for shocks in the six LEGGOS sources. We conclude by discussing the implications of the lack of evidence for shocks in the broader context of galaxy evolution at cosmic noon and earlier epochs.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 在此，我们展示了利用JWST/NIRSpec积分场光谱，对来自LEGGOS巡天（LEnsing and Galaxy Growth: Observing Substructures）的六个引力透镜星系（2.37 < z < 3.625）进行的首次系统性激波搜寻。我们采用了利用激波敏感的静止系光学发射线H\b{eta}、[O iii] λ5008、[O i] λ6302、Hα、[N ii] λ6585和[S ii] λλ6718, 6733的通量和运动学诊断。我们发现，在像素、团块和星系积分尺度上，LEGGOS光谱显示出极少甚至没有激波证据。对于任何单个星系，图像平面像素中位于静止系光学线比诊断的激波区域内的比例< 8%，且被识别为激波的像素并未显示出连贯的空间结构。我们还利用MAPPINGS V激波模型从观测到的发射线推断激波速度，发现推断的激波速度分布与激波主导气体所预期的分布不一致。总之，这些方法均未为六个LEGGOS源中的激波提供显著证据。最后，我们讨论了缺乏激波证据在宇宙正午及更早时期星系演化的更广泛背景下的意义。

title: The MICADO first light imager for the ELT: Simulated Observations of Star Forming Clumps at Cosmic Noon
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publication in MNRAS
summary: Galaxies at redshift z$\sim$2-6 exhibit prominent star-forming regions (clumps). Characterisation of these galactic structures requires both high sensitivity and spatial resolution of $\sim$100 pc or less. Currently, these spatial scales are achievable only with the aid of strong gravitational lensing. However, lensing introduces model-dependent uncertainties and limits the sample to galaxies behind massive clusters. The upcoming 40m-class telescopes, such as the ESO Extremely Large Telescope (ELT), will enable routine studies of clumps in ubiquitous, non-lensed z$\ge$2 galaxies. We assess the capability of MICADO, the first-light imager and spectrograph of the ELT, to characterise clumps in non-lensed z=2 galaxies. Specifically, we focus on two representative observing scenarios, providing the basis for an early scientific exploitation of the instrument. We modelled clumps in an idealised z=2 star-forming galaxy and produced mock MICADO observations in both broad- and narrow-band imaging. The latter leverages the strong emission lines typical of clumps to improve detection and characterisation. Reaching UV rest-frame magnitudes of clumps as faint as M$_{UV} \sim -15$ in optimal observing conditions, MICADO will be able to efficiently characterise clumps in non-lensed z=2 galaxies down to R$_{e} \sim 20$ pc. Moreover, the full MICADO $\sim$1 arcmin$^2$ field of view enables efficient surveys of multiple targets. This study demonstrates MICADO's potential to fill a crucial observational gap, shedding new light on clump formation and evolution at cosmic noon. Accurate PSF reconstruction will be crucial to fully harness this capability as it significantly impacts clump detection and characterisation, especially at the smallest sizes ($<$40 pc).

title: ADF22-WEB: Massive galaxy formation shaped by cosmic web filaments in the z = 3.1 proto-cluster core
summary: We present a census of dust, molecular gas, and galaxy structure in 18 dusty star-forming galaxies (DSFGs) at $z=3.09$ embedded in Ly$α$-traced cosmic web filaments in the core of the SSA22 proto-cluster, using multi-band ALMA, JWST imaging, and JVLA CO(1--0). Using up to six ALMA bands and Herschel/SPIRE data, we construct rest-frame far-infrared spectral energy distributions. The DSFGs span two orders of magnitude in far-infrared luminosity ($L_{\rm FIR}\sim10^{11}$--$10^{13}L_\odot$), with median values of $\log(L_{\rm FIR}/L_\odot)=11.56^{+0.32}_{-0.37}$ and $T_{\rm dust}=25^{+6}_{-3}{\rm K}$. For eight DSFGs with high-resolution ($\sim1$ kpc) JWST and ALMA imaging, we measure stellar and dust surface densities and find a positive correlation, suggesting that structural compaction of the stellar component proceeds together with that of the interstellar medium. We report 12 detections of CO(1--0), 18 of CO(3--2), four each of CO(8--7) and CO(9--8), and one of CO(12--11). The median brightness temperature ratio between CO(3--2) and CO(1--0) is $r_{31}=0.66^{+0.05}_{-0.04}$, consistent with field galaxies at similar redshifts. The high-$J$ CO lines show relatively low excitation, and the CO(8--7)/CO(3--2) ratio correlates with star-formation rate surface density, suggesting that molecular gas excitation is primarily regulated by star formation. Lower-mass galaxies show excess molecular gas fractions and depletion times relative to field scaling relations. By combining quiescent galaxy samples in the same field, we identify a sequence from gas-rich systems with low stellar surface density to gas-poor, compact systems with high stellar surface density. These results suggest that massive galaxy evolution in dense environments is governed by a baryon cycle linking gas supply, star formation, and structural transformation within the cosmic web environment.

AI.motivation: 理解高红移原星系团中密集环境下大质量星系的演化机制，特别是尘埃恒星形成星系在宇宙网纤维中的气体供应、恒星形成与结构演化之间的耦合关系。

AI.result: DSFGs的远红外光度跨越10^11-10^13太阳光度，中位尘埃温度为25K；恒星与尘埃面密度呈正相关；检测到多阶CO谱线发射，中位r31=0.66；CO(8-7)/CO(3-2)比率与恒星形成面密度相关；低质量星系表现出分子气体过剩和解耗尽时间偏长。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们利用多波段ALMA、JWST成像和JVLA CO(1--0)数据，对SSA22原星系团核心中嵌入Ly$\alpha$示踪的宇宙网纤维内的18个尘埃恒星形成星系（DSFGs）在$z=3.09$处的尘埃、分子气体和星系结构进行了普查。利用多达六个ALMA波段和Herschel/SPIRE数据，我们构建了静止系远红外光谱能量分布。这些DSFG的远红外光度跨越两个数量级（$L_{\rm FIR}\sim10^{11}$--$10^{13}L_\odot$），中值分别为$\log(L_{\rm FIR}/L_\odot)=11.56^{+0.32}_{-0.37}$和$T_{\rm dust}=25^{+6}_{-3}{\rm K}$。对于八个具有高分辨率（$\sim1$ kpc）JWST和ALMA成像的DSFG，我们测量了恒星和尘埃面密度，并发现它们之间存在正相关，表明恒星成分的结构致密化与星际介质的结构致密化同步进行。我们报告了12个CO(1--0)、18个CO(3--2)、各4个CO(8--7)和CO(9--8)以及1个CO(12--11)的探测。CO(3--2)与CO(1--0)之间的中值亮温度比为$r_{31}=0.66^{+0.05}_{-0.04}$，与类似红移的场星系一致。高$J$ CO谱线显示出相对较低的激发，且CO(8--7)/CO(3--2)比值与恒星形成率面密度相关，表明分子气体激发主要受恒星形成调控。较低质量星系相对于场标度关系表现出过量的分子气体比例和消耗时间。通过结合同一场中的静止星系样本，我们识别出一个从富含气体、低恒星面密度的系统到贫气体、致密且高恒星面密度的系统的序列。这些结果表明，在密集环境中，大质量星系的演化受重子循环支配，该循环将气体供应、恒星形成和结构转变紧密联系在宇宙网环境中。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于提供的摘要，结论为：密集环境中大质量星系的演化由重子循环支配，该循环将气体供应、恒星形成与结构转变紧密联系在宇宙网环境中。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: ALMA 1.17 mm map of the ADF22 field in the \(z=3.1\) SSA22 proto-cluster core, shown in grayscale. Ly \(\alpha\) filaments are overlaid as colored regions for comparison ( Umehata et al. (2019) ). The representative coverages of ALMA Band 3, Band 8, and JVLA Ka-band are shown as orange, blue, and red contours, respectively, corresponding to regions with a primary beam response \(>30\%\) . For ALMA Band 3, two additional deep pointings are available besides the wide mosaic. The 18 DSFGs and 3 QGs at \(z_{spec}\simeq 3.09\) are labeled ( Umehata et al. (2015) ; Umehata et al. (2019) ; Huang et al. (2025) ). The ADF22 DSFGs, many of which lie along the filaments, are largely encompassed by these coverages as well as JWST/NIRCam and/or MIRI imaging ( Umehata et al. (2026) ), enabling a joint characterization of molecular gas, dust spectral energy distributions, and stellar properties within the filamentary structure. Alt text: A map indicating observation regions.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：ADF22场在\(z=3.1\) SSA22原星系团核心的ALMA 1.17 mm图，以灰度显示。Ly \(\alpha\) 纤维以彩色区域叠加用于比较（Umehata et al. (2019)）。ALMA Band 3、Band 8和JVLA Ka-band的代表性覆盖范围分别以橙色、蓝色和红色轮廓显示，对应于主波束响应\(>30\%\)的区域。对于ALMA Band 3，除了宽马赛克外，还有两个额外的深场指向。18个DSFG和3个QGs在\(z_{spec}\simeq 3.09\)处被标记（Umehata et al. (2015)；Umehata et al. (2019)；Huang et al. (2025)）。ADF22 DSFG，其中许多位于纤维上，大部分被这些覆盖范围以及JWST/NIRCam和/或MIRI成像（Umehata et al. (2026)）所包含，从而能够在纤维结构内联合表征分子气体、尘埃光谱能量分布和恒星性质。替代文本：显示观测区域的图。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: ALMA and JWST views of the 18 DSFGs in the ADF22 field at \(z_{spec}\simeq 3.09\) . Background color images show pseudo-color composites of the JWST NIRCam F200W, F356W, and F444W data ( Umehata et al. (2026) ). For sources not covered by the NIRCam imaging, single-band MIRI images are shown in grayscale as labeled. Contours indicate the ALMA 1.17 mm emission at \(3\) , \(6\) , and \(9\sigma\) ( Huang et al. (2025) ). Each panel is centered on the source indicated by the corresponding ID label. The JWST images reveal diverse stellar morphologies among the DSFGs, ranging from compact sources to extended and multiple-component systems. Each panel is \(7^{\prime\prime}\times 7^{\prime\prime}\) , corresponding to \(\sim 54\) kpc at \(z=3.09\) . Alt text: Images of target galaxies.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：ADF22场中18个DSFG在\(z_{spec}\simeq 3.09\)处的ALMA和JWST视图。背景彩色图像显示JWST NIRCam F200W、F356W和F444W数据的伪彩色合成（Umehata et al. (2026)）。对于未被NIRCam成像覆盖的源，以灰度显示单波段MIRI图像，如标记所示。轮廓表示ALMA 1.17 mm发射在\(3\)、\(6\)和\(9\sigma\)处（Huang et al. (2025)）。每个面板以相应ID标签指示的源为中心。JWST图像揭示了DSFG中多样的恒星形态，从致密源到延展和多组件系统。每个面板为\(7^{\prime\prime}\times 7^{\prime\prime}\)，对应于\(\sim 54\) kpc在\(z=3.09\)处。替代文本：目标星系的图像。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Spectral energy distributions (SEDs) of the 18 DSFGs at \(z\simeq 3.09\) . Each panel shows the observed-frame flux density \(F_{\nu}\) (mJy) as a function of the observed wavelength, \(\lambda_{obs}\) ( \(\mu\) m). Filled circles with error bars indicate detections, while arrows denote 3 \(\sigma\) upper limits. The solid curve represents the maximum-likelihood SED obtained using the mercurius fitting routine ( Witstok et al. (2022) ). The shaded region shows the 16th–84th percentile range of the posterior distribution at each wavelength. The inferred dust temperature and dust emissivity index are indicated in each panel. Alt text: spectral energy distributions.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：18个DSFG在\(z\simeq 3.09\)处的光谱能量分布（SEDs）。每个面板显示观测框架通量密度\(F_{\nu}\)（mJy）作为观测波长\(\lambda_{obs}\)（\(\mu\)m）的函数。带误差条的实心圆表示探测，箭头表示3 \(\sigma\)上限。实线表示使用mercurius拟合程序（Witstok et al. (2022)）获得的最大似然SED。阴影区域显示每个波长处后验分布的16-84百分位范围。推断的尘埃温度和尘埃发射率指数在每个面板中指示。替代文本：光谱能量分布。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Relation between the far-infrared luminosity ( \(L_{FIR}\) ) and dust temperature ( \(T_{dust}\) ) for the ADF22 DSFGs at \(z\simeq 3.09\) (orange circles). For comparison, SPT-selected DSFGs at \(z_{spec}=2.6-3.6\) ( Reuter et al. (2020) ) and AS2UDS DSFGs at \(z_{phot}=2.6-3.6\) ( Dudzevičiūtė et al. (2020) ) are shown as blue and grey symbols, respectively. For the AS2UDS sample, \(L_{FIR}\) is approximated as \(0.8\,L_{IR}\) to match the wavelength range considered. The ADF22 DSFGs occupy a lower-luminosity and moderately warm dust regime, representative of less extreme dusty star-forming galaxies at \(z\sim 3\) . Alt text: Relation between luminosity and temperature.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：ADF22 DSFG在\(z\simeq 3.09\)处的远红外光度（\(L_{FIR}\)）与尘埃温度（\(T_{dust}\)）之间的关系（橙色圆圈）。作为比较，SPT选择的DSFG在\(z_{spec}=2.6-3.6\)（Reuter et al. (2020)）和AS2UDS DSFG在\(z_{phot}=2.6-3.6\)（Dudzevičiūtė et al. (2020)）分别以蓝色和灰色符号显示。对于AS2UDS样本，\(L_{FIR}\)近似为\(0.8\,L_{IR}\)以匹配所考虑的波长范围。ADF22 DSFG占据较低光度和中等温暖尘埃区域，代表在\(z\sim 3\)处较不极端的尘埃恒星形成星系。替代文本：光度与温度之间的关系。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Relation between far-infrared surface brightness, dust temperature, stellar mass surface density, and dust mass surface density for the ADF22 DSFGs at \(z\simeq 3.09\) . (a) Dust temperature ( \(T_{dust}\) ) as a function of far-infrared surface brightness, \(\Sigma_{FIR}=L_{FIR}/(2\pi R_{e}^{2})\) . The dashed line shows the expected scaling for optically thin dust emission with \(\beta=2\) , normalized to the median \(\Sigma_{dust}\) of the sample. Colors indicate the dust mass surface density, \(\Sigma_{dust}\) , showing that the offset from the relation depends on \(\Sigma_{dust}\) . (b) Dust mass surface density, \(\Sigma_{dust}=M_{dust}/(2\pi R_{e,dust}^{2})\) , versus stellar mass surface density, \(\Sigma_{\star}=M_{\star}/(2\pi R_{{e},{JWST}}^{2})\) . Colors indicate \(\Sigma_{FIR}\) . The two surface densities broadly correlate, indicating coupled mass concentration in the stellar component and the cold ISM. The shaded region marks the compact (compaction) regime defined by \(\log\Sigma_{\star}\gtrsim 9.5\ ({M_{\odot}\,kpc^{-2}})\) ( Barro et al. (2017) ), where the most compact DSFGs are located. Alt text: Diagrams showing temperature and density
figures.caption_zh: 图5：ADF22 DSFG在\(z\simeq 3.09\)处的远红外表面亮度、尘埃温度、恒星质量面密度和尘埃质量面密度之间的关系。(a) 尘埃温度（\(T_{dust}\)）作为远红外表面亮度\(\Sigma_{FIR}=L_{FIR}/(2\pi R_{e}^{2})\)的函数。虚线显示光学薄尘埃发射的预期标度，\(\beta=2\)，归一化到样本的中值\(\Sigma_{dust}\)。颜色表示尘埃质量面密度\(\Sigma_{dust}\)，显示与关系的偏移取决于\(\Sigma_{dust}\)。(b) 尘埃质量面密度\(\Sigma_{dust}=M_{dust}/(2\pi R_{e,dust}^{2})\)与恒星质量面密度\(\Sigma_{\star}=M_{\star}/(2\pi R_{{e},{JWST}}^{2})\)的关系。颜色表示\(\Sigma_{FIR}\)。两个面密度大致相关，表明恒星成分和冷ISM中的质量集中是耦合的。阴影区域标记由\(\log\Sigma_{\star}\gtrsim 9.5\ ({M_{\odot}\,kpc^{-2}})\)（Barro et al. (2017)）定义的致密（压实）区域，最致密的DSFG位于其中。替代文本：显示温度和密度的图表。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: CO(3–2) and CO(1–0) spectra of the 18 DSFGs at \(z\simeq 3.09\) in the ADF22 field. The CO(3–2) spectra are shown in orange, extracted using apertures defined by the imfit positions and convolved source sizes, and the best-fit Gaussian models are overplotted with orange curves. If the CO(1–0) line is detected, the spectra are shown in blue, extracted using apertures corresponding to the synthesized beam size (for clarity, the flux density is multiplied by a factor of three). The velocity axis is defined relative to the systemic redshift derived from the CO(3–2) line. The bluer components in the A11 panel comes from A4 and hence not included in the fit. CO(3–2) emission is detected in all 18 galaxies, while CO(1–0) is detected in 12 DSFGs, providing a comprehensive view of the molecular gas reservoirs in DSFGs within the \(z\simeq 3.09\) proto-cluster core. Alt text: spectra.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：ADF22场中18个DSFG在\(z\simeq 3.09\)处的CO(3–2)和CO(1–0)光谱。CO(3–2)光谱以橙色显示，使用由imfit位置和卷积源大小定义的孔径提取，最佳拟合高斯模型以橙色曲线叠加。如果检测到CO(1–0)线，光谱以蓝色显示，使用对应于合成波束大小的孔径提取（为清晰起见，通量密度乘以因子三）。速度轴相对于从CO(3–2)线导出的系统红移定义。A11面板中的蓝色成分来自A4，因此不包含在拟合中。所有18个星系都检测到CO(3–2)发射，而12个DSFG检测到CO(1–0)，提供了在\(z\simeq 3.09\)原星系团核心内DSFG分子气体储层的全面视图。替代文本：光谱。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Relation between CO(1–0) luminosity and dust mass for the ADF22 DSFGs. Open circles denote galaxies with direct CO(1–0) detections, while filled squares indicate sources for which \(L^{\prime}_{CO(1-0)}\) is inferred from CO(3–2) using the median excitation ratio of the sample. The black solid line shows the relation expected for \(\alpha_{CO}=3.6\) and \({GDR}=100\) . For comparison, the black dotted and dashed lines show the relations for \(\alpha_{CO}=0.8\) and \(\alpha_{CO}=1.36\) , respectively. The orange dash–dotted line represents the relation implied by the median \(M_{dust}/L^{\prime}_{CO(1-0)}\) ratio measured for the ADF22 DSFGs ( \(\alpha_{CO}=2.1\) for \({GDR}=100\) ). Most sources lie within the region encompassed by \(\alpha_{CO}=0.8\) –3.6, although substantial source-to-source variations are also present. Alt text: diagram of CO luminosity and dust mass.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：ADF22 DSFG的CO(1–0)光度与尘埃质量之间的关系。空心圆表示直接检测到CO(1–0)的星系，实心方块表示通过样本的中值激发比从CO(3–2)推断出\(L^{\prime}_{CO(1-0)}\)的源。黑色实线显示\(\alpha_{CO}=3.6\)和\({GDR}=100\)的预期关系。作为比较，黑色虚线和点线分别显示\(\alpha_{CO}=0.8\)和\(\alpha_{CO}=1.36\)的关系。橙色点划线表示由ADF22 DSFG测量的中值\(M_{dust}/L^{\prime}_{CO(1-0)}\)比值所隐含的关系（\(\alpha_{CO}=2.1\)对于\({GDR}=100\)）。大多数源位于\(\alpha_{CO}=0.8\)–3.6所包围的区域内，尽管也存在显著的源间变化。替代文本：CO光度和尘埃质量的图表。

figures.caption_en: Figure 8: (left) CO SLEDs of the four ADF22 DSFGs with high- \(J\) CO detections, normalized to the CO(3–2) transition. For comparison, the CO SLEDs of a compilation of DSFGs ( Hagimoto et al., 2023 ; Tadaki, 2026 ) and two individual DSFGs ( Danielson et al., 2011 ; Boogaard et al., 2026 ) are shown with the same normalization. The high- \(J\) CO lines of the ADF22 DSFGs generally exhibit relatively low excitation compared to other DSFGs, although the high- \(J\) excitation regime remains relatively poorly constrained. (right) Relation between \(\Sigma_{SFR}\) and the flux ratio \(S_{CO(8-7)}\Delta v/S_{CO(3-2)}\Delta v\) for the four ADF22 DSFGs, compared with another DSFG ( Taylor et al. (2025) ) and the theoretical model of Narayanan and Krumholz (2014) . The ADF22 DSFGs are color-coded by \(T_{dust}\) , while AS2COS0139.1 is shown separately with its dust temperature indicated. The observed values generally follow the model track, suggesting that the molecular gas excitation in the ADF22 DSFGs is primarily regulated by intense star formation. Alt text: CO SLEDs.
figures.caption_zh: 图8：（左）四个具有高\(J\) CO探测的ADF22 DSFG的CO SLEDs，归一化到CO(3–2)跃迁。作为比较，DSFG汇编（Hagimoto et al., 2023；Tadaki, 2026）和两个单独DSFG（Danielson et al., 2011；Boogaard et al., 2026）的CO SLEDs以相同归一化显示。ADF22 DSFG的高\(J\) CO线通常表现出相对较低的激发，与其他DSFG相比，尽管高\(J\)激发区域仍相对缺乏约束。（右）四个ADF22 DSFG的\(\Sigma_{SFR}\)与通量比\(S_{CO(8-7)}\Delta v/S_{CO(3-2)}\Delta v\)之间的关系，与另一个DSFG（Taylor et al. (2025)）和Narayanan and Krumholz (2014)的理论模型进行比较。ADF22 DSFG按\(T_{dust}\)着色，而AS2COS0139.1单独显示并指示其尘埃温度。观测值通常遵循模型轨迹，表明ADF22 DSFG中的分子气体激发主要受强烈恒星形成调控。替代文本：CO SLEDs。
